content:
SRE weekly ops sync notes - 2026-03-17 (draft)

Goal: Review reliability signals, confirm follow-ups from last incidents, reduce paging noise, and agree on short-term mitigations.

Agenda:
- Metrics snapshot
- Top incidents
- Paging trends
- Action items

Metrics (quick):
- Prod error budget: 18% remaining (30d window). still within safety but trending down.
- P99 latency: 210ms (7d), slight regression after rolling deploy on 3/12. tail lifts observed at high concurrency.
- Pages: 42 last week (↑18% WoW). Many pages correlated with scheduled job failures and probe flaps.
- MTTA / MTTR: 2.1m / 3h40m.

Incidents (notes):
- INC-2026-05 (3/12): routing flap during deploy. symptom: KV cache cold start + node reboot order meant some requests hit new nodes without warmed caches -> high tail latency -> retries -> partial cascading. Rollback restored baseline. Root cause: kube drain playbook triggered reboots without honoring warmup annotation. Temporary mitigation: enforce podWarmup controller; long-term: add pre-drain cache warming + adjust rollout order.
- SRE-4123 (3/14): tokenization errors from model-adapter v1.2.1 due to migration change in tokenizer lib; hotfix v1.2.2 deployed. Observability: error surfaced in logs, not in SLO dashboards. Need a metric.

Paging trends + noise:
- 60% of pages in last 4 weeks from cronjob health-checks and noisy k8s readiness/liveness flaps.
- Proposed: add dedupe + silence for non-actionable cron job alerts; add escalation policy for user-impacting incidents only.

Action items (see list above).

Open questions / items to discuss:
- Should we temporarily lower autoscale thresholds for gen endpoints during peak hours? tradeoff: cost vs. tail latency.
- How aggressively to silence pages from dedicated infra vs hosted infra? confirm with CS for Dedicated customers.

Links:
- SLO dashboard: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/SLO+Dashboard
- Incident ticket: INC-2026-05
- Fix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/874

Notes to self:
- Remind infra to coordinate kernel upgrades with SRE next time; consider blackout window.
- Follow up on SRE-4131 (tokenization metric) before next deploy.
